info.title: Chuhai Lips: Canned Flavor of Married Women
info.synopsis: Tsuyoshi, un ventiduenne al terzo anno dell'università, trascorre le sue giornate tra le lezioni ed il suo lavoro di fattorino, con una lattina di chūhai sempre a portata di mano. Vivendo da solo in un piccolo appartamento, la sua vita prende una piega inaspettata quando fa la conoscenza di Yui Koriyama, una donna sposata che ammira fin dall'infanzia. Quello che inizia come un legame innocente si trasforma ben presto in qualcosa di molto più intimo che trascende i confini del desiderio e della moralità. In uno scenario di notti tranquille e momenti rubati, questo racconto tanto comico quanto audace, esplora le emozioni e le complicazioni di una storia d'amore illecita dove ogni incontro è inebriante ma al tempo stesso, molto pericoloso.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Tsuyoshi, a third-year college student, leads a lazy life drinking cheap and tasty canned chuhai. One day, his aunt, Yui Koriyama, who he has a soft spot for, pays him an unexpected visit.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: On a midsummer's day, Tsuyoshi heads to the convenience store to get chuhai, and reunites with Ai Natsuno, his junior from high school. Ai is now married, with a huge makeover as a sun-kissed gyaru, but acts like a spoiled child around Tsuyoshi, just like she used to.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Tsuyoshi starts an online drinking session with his two guy friends, and the college idol senpai, Miki Kanzaki. As Miki gets drunk from canned chuhai and exposes herself on screen, Tsuyoshi and the gang can't take their eyes off her.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Tsuyoshi goes round Joseph's house and meets his older sister and married Russian beauty, Anastasia. The three have canned chuhai, but Anastasia gets dead drunk and mistakes Tsuyoshi for her younger brother. He ends up taking care of her, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: One night when Tsuyoshi was wandering around town with canned chuhai in his hand, he meets a wild tanuki, and gets led to a big mansion. There he meets a tanuki-faced beauty, Tamami Miyazawa, who gives him a warm reception, but for a certain reason...

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: By chance, Tsuyoshi ends up having a one-night stand with Nozomi Kuji, a married woman who looks too young for her age. Since then, they've become canned chuhai drinking buddies. In the midst of this, Nozomi vents out her frustration about her busty-loving hubby, and Tsuyoshi gets lectured on the appeal of small breasts...

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Tsuyoshi enters a parallel universe and saves a dark elf beauty, Symphis with the skill he gained from the chuhai god. Tsuyoshi gradually becomes drawn to Symphis as she talks about her husband, but something doesn't add up...

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: As Tsuyoshi goes to his regular barbershop, the quiet forty-odd beauty owner, Sari Kirihara, announces that the shop will be closing down. Tsuyoshi ends up drinking canned chuhai at Sari's house without the presence of her husband, but realizing her secret feelings, tries to snuggle up to her...
